assumptions: USD million; số ca và trọng số. Bệnh viện giả lập Bông Sen. Toy doanh thu theo DRG, không suy diễn clinical outcome.

evidence.text: [Bảng ca] Nhóm nhẹ 1.000 ca, trọng số0,8; nhóm nặng 500 ca, trọng số2,4. Cùng giá cơ sở $5.000/weight.
[Chi phí] Nhóm nhẹ $3.500/ca, nặng $10.000/ca. Quản lý chung1m.
[Điều chỉnh] Khoản khấu trừ payer đã xác nhận .5m giảm doanh thu, không phân bổ theo nhóm. Không thuế.
[Giới hạn] Trọng số phản ánh tài nguyên tương đối; không có tử vong, kết quả hay chi phí bệnh nhân riêng.

qas.question: Find total case-weight units across the two DRG groups.
Find case-mix index on total discharges.
Find gross DRG consideration before payer deduction.
Find total operating result after payer deduction and central expense.
Can the .5m deduction be allocated precisely between DRG groups?
qas.answer: No. The payer deduction has no group breakdown.

qas.question: Why is the 1.3333 index not a clinical quality score?
qas.answer: It weights relative resource complexity, not patient outcomes.

qas.question: Can the exact profit of each DRG group after payer deduction and central overhead be determined?
qas.answer: No. Both deduction and shared overhead lack approved allocations.

qas.question: Would counting 2,000 weight units as 2,000 physical patients be correct?
qas.answer: No. There are 1,500 episodes; weights are not patient counts.

assumptions: Tỷ VND, triệu km. Công ty giả lập Cánh Chim. Toy emissions metrics khác mẫu số.

evidence.text: [Hoạt động] 2024 tổng km80m, loaded60m, freight tonne-km400m; emissions40kt CO2e. 2025 total km90m, loaded63m, tonne-km450m; emissions42kt.
[Tài chính] 2025 revenue800 tỷ, fuel cost260, other opex450. Không thuế.
[Định nghĩa] Intensity theo tonne-km = kt/million tonne-km (kg/t-km); theo vehicle km tương tự. Không trộn denominator.
[Giới hạn] Không số lít, fuel mix, emission factors by vehicle.

qas.question: Find 2025 loaded-distance utilization.
Find 2025 freight carbon intensity in kg per tonne-km.
Find relative change in tonne-km emissions intensity from 2024.
Find 2025 operating result.
qas.answer: 800−260−450=90 billion VND.

qas.question: Why can absolute emissions rise while tonne-km intensity falls?
qas.answer: Freight activity increased more than emissions; absolute total and normalized intensity measure different things.

qas.question: Can the intensity improvement be attributed exclusively to reduced empty running?
qas.answer: No. Fuel mix, vehicle efficiency, load and distance mix may change; no causal breakdown.

qas.question: Should loaded-km intensity be directly compared to tonne-km intensity as the same KPI?
qas.answer: No. The denominators and physical units are different.

qas.question: Can liters of diesel consumed be determined from emissions42kt?
qas.answer: No. Fuel emission factors and fuel mix are absent.

assumptions: Tỷ VND, triệu thuê bao. Nhà mạng giả lập Hạt Mây. Chỉ dùng metric defined.

evidence.text: [2024] 1m active data SIMs average, monthly average usage8 GB/SIM, median4 GB. Retail data revenue960 tỷ.
[2025] 1,2m average active data SIMs, average10 GB, median3 GB. Retail data revenue1.080 tỷ; device revenue200 tỷ.
[KPI] Data ARPU = annual retail data revenue / average active data SIMs /12. Aggregate usage from average×count×12.
[Giới hạn] Không user-level distribution, package price/usage relation hoặc unique persons.

qas.question: Find annual aggregate 2025 data usage in million GB.
Find annual aggregate 2024 data usage.
qas.answer: 1×8×12=96 million GB.

qas.question: Find 2025 monthly retail data ARPU in VND.
Find 2024 monthly ARPU on the matched scope.
Does higher average usage prove every user's consumption increased?
qas.answer: No. Median falls from4 to3; average can rise due to heavy users. Individual changes unknown.

qas.question: Can the 200b device sales be added to data ARPU numerator?
qas.answer: No. The KPI excludes device consideration.

qas.question: Can the share of users consuming over20GB be inferred?
qas.answer: No. Mean and median do not identify the tail distribution.

qas.question: Can a causal relationship between plan prices and usage be established?
qas.answer: No. Package prices, user cohorts and counterfactual evidence are absent.

assumptions: Triệu USD; triệu ASK/RPK. Hãng giả lập Vòm Trời. Chỉ số network weighted by activity.

evidence.text: [Domestic] 2024 ASK1000, RPK800, fare revenue120. 2025 ASK900, RPK720, revenue108.
[International] 2024 ASK500, RPK350, revenue70. 2025 ASK800, RPK560, revenue112.
[KPI] Load factor=RPK/ASK; passenger yield=fare revenue/RPK. Không cargo/ancillary trong hai metric.
[Giới hạn] Không chi phí theo tuyến, số chuyến, passenger count hoặc tác động marketing.

qas.question: Find combined 2024 load factor.
Find combined 2025 load factor.
Find combined 2025 passenger yield.
Find 2024 network passenger yield.
Why did network load factor fall despite unchanged load factor within each region?
qas.answer: The mix shifted toward international routes with 70% load factor versus domestic80%.

qas.question: Why did network yield rise despite unchanged route yields?
qas.answer: International has $.20/RPK versus domestic$.15; its RPK share increased.

qas.question: Can the expanded international network be declared more profitable?
qas.answer: No. Route costs, cargo contribution and capital utilization are missing.

qas.question: Can number of passengers be inferred from RPK?
qas.answer: No. RPK combines passenger count and distance; distance per passenger is missing.

assumptions: Tỷ VND, nghìn tấn; giá USD/tấn. Công ty giả lập Hương Quế. Toy bridge uses ordered volume, USD price, FX.

evidence.text: [2024] Export volume20kt, price$2,000/t, average FX25 nghìn VND/USD.
[2025] Volume22kt, price$1,800/t, average FX26 nghìn VND/USD. All sold. Revenue tỷ = kt×USD/t×kVND/USD/1000.
[Bridge] Volume effect at old price/FX; price effect at current volume/old FX; FX effect at current volume/current price.
[Giới hạn] No grade mix, customer profitability or future hedge information.

qas.question: Find 2024 translated export revenue.
Find 2025 translated export revenue.
Find ordered volume effect under the prescribed bridge.
Find ordered USD price effect.
Find ordered FX effect.
Why did VND revenue increase despite lower USD unit price?
qas.answer: The positive volume100 and FX39.6 outweigh price−110, net +29.6.

qas.question: Can the USD price decline be attributed to lower quality?
qas.answer: No. Grade, contracts and market benchmark changes are not supplied.

qas.question: Can profit improvement be established from this revenue bridge?
qas.answer: No. Costs, FX on costs, financing and taxes are absent.

assumptions: Tỷ VND. Đại học giả lập Rừng Bút. Toy output indicator on funded project cohort.

evidence.text: [2024] Nghiên cứu funded cohort cost80 tỷ, 40 peer-reviewed publications. Total university publications100 including unfunded.
[2025] Funded cohort cost120, 48 publications; university total130. Signed grant receipts150, earned eligible grant revenue110.
[Policy] Cost per funded publication = funded cohort cost/funded publications. Grant cash distinct from revenue.
[Giới hạn] No citation impact, discipline mix, patents, time lags or research quality.

qas.question: Find funded-cohort publication growth.
Find 2025 cost per funded publication.
qas.answer: 120/48=2.5 billion VND.

qas.question: Find 2024 comparable cost per funded publication.
qas.answer: 80/40=2 billion VND.

qas.question: Find difference between grant cash receipts and earned grant revenue.
qas.answer: 150−110=40 billion VND; not necessarily final liability without opening balances.

qas.question: Why not use all university publications130 as the denominator for funded cost120?
qas.answer: The numerator covers funded projects only; total university outputs include other scope.

qas.question: Can increased cost per publication prove research quality fell?
qas.answer: No. Discipline, quality, project complexity and time lags differ and are unmeasured.

qas.question: Can the 40 difference be identified as exact closing deferred grant liability?
qas.answer: No. Opening grant balances and movements are missing.

qas.question: Should 150 cash receipts replace earned110 in current grant revenue?
qas.answer: No. Cash and eligible earned consideration are distinct.

assumptions: Triệu USD; nghìn tonnes. Mỏ giả lập Mạch Đá. Toy grade/recovery weighted by contained metal.

evidence.text: [Feed] Pit A ore600kt, grade2%, recovery90%; Pit B ore400kt, grade1%, recovery70%. No payability adjustment.
[Sales] All recovered metal sold at $7,000/t. Treatment cost5m, other production cost70m.
[KPI] Head grade weighted by ore; overall recovery weighted by contained metal; not simple mean of pit rates.
[Giới hạn] No grade reconciliation beyond feed, future reserve or customer-level data.

qas.question: Find total contained metal in feed.
Find total recovered metal.
Find weighted head grade.
Find aggregate recovery weighted by contained metal.
Find gross metal sales consideration.
Why does arithmetic average recovery80% understate the aggregate?
qas.answer: A contributes more contained metal, and its higher recovery receives greater weight.

qas.question: Can future recovery be assumed85% regardless of grade mix?
qas.answer: No. Changing source proportions or metallurgy changes aggregate recovery.

qas.question: Can mine life be inferred from processed ore1000kt?
qas.answer: No. Reserve quantity and future mine plan are missing.

assumptions: Tỷ VND; triệu kWh. Utility giả lập Mạch Nước. Toy bill averages, không suy diễn khả năng chi trả.

evidence.text: [Households] 2024 1m customers, consumption1.800m kWh, billed3.240 tỷ. 2025 1,1m customers, consumption1.870m kWh, billed3.553 tỷ.
[Costs] 2025 power cost2.500, network expense650, D&A250. Không thuế.

[Giới hạn] No household income, consumption distribution, subsidies by income or arrears aging.

qas.question: Find average 2024 tariff in thousand VND/kWh.
Find 2025 average tariff.
qas.answer: 3553/1870=1.9 thousand VND/kWh.

qas.question: Find average household annual consumption in 2025.
Find average monthly household bill in 2025.
Find operating result from 2025 revenue/cost disclosure.
Does higher average tariff prove all household bills increased?
qas.answer: No. Consumption and tariff mix differ by household; aggregate averages do not establish individual outcomes.

qas.question: Can energy affordability relative to income be calculated?
qas.answer: No. Household income and bill distribution are missing.

qas.question: Can the change in consumption be attributed to price elasticity?
qas.answer: No. Weather, customer mix, efficiency, income and counterfactual data are absent.
